COPY <<'APPLIANCE' /.bayt/process-compose.appliance.yaml
version: "0.5"
processes:
  database:
    command: '''docker-entrypoint.sh'' ''postgres'' ''-c'' ''session_preload_libraries=pg_ivm'' ''-c'' ''wal_level=logical'' ''-c'' ''max_replication_slots=128'' ''-c'' ''max_wal_senders=128'' ''-c'' ''fsync=off'' ''-c'' ''synchronous_commit=off'' ''-c'' ''full_page_writes=off'' ''-c'' ''shared_buffers=32MB'' ''-c'' ''max_connections=200'' ''-c'' ''fsync=on'' ''-c'' ''synchronous_commit=on'' ''-c'' ''full_page_writes=on'' ''-c'' ''shared_buffers=512MB'''
  electric:
    command: '''env'' ''DATABASE_URL=postgresql://electric:${ELECTRIC_PASSWORD:-dev-electric-password}@127.0.0.1:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-truco}?sslmode=disable'' ''ELECTRIC_SECRET=${ELECTRIC_SECRET:-dev-electric-secret}'' ''ELECTRIC_MANUAL_TABLE_PUBLISHING=true'' ''ELECTRIC_PORT=3002'' ''ELECTRIC_STORAGE_DIR=${PGDATA:-/var/lib/pgsql/data}/electric'' ''LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/electric-libs'' ''ELIXIR_ERL_OPTIONS=+fnu'' ''/electric-app/bin/entrypoint'' ''start'''
  ticker:
    command: '''ticker-deno'' ''run'' ''--frozen'' ''--allow-net'' ''--allow-env'' ''main.ts'''
    working_dir: /ticker-app
    environment:
      - CRUD_URL=http://crud:3000
      - CALL_TIMEOUT_MS=35000
      - SERVICE_JWT=${SERVICE_JWT:-eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJyb2xlIjoic2VydmljZSIsInN1YiI6IjAwMDAwMDAwLTAwMDAtMDAwMC0wMDAwLTAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMCIsImV4cCI6MTk4ODE1MDQwMH0.dGYz_sMSnOvZy0eANh7spJbgyr2fEzeynOERIqW7gd4}
      - DENO_DIR=/ticker-deno-dir
      - PORT=9998
      - WAKE_URLS=
    depends_on:
      crud:
        condition: process_healthy
    readiness_probe:
      exec:
        command: portcheck --port 9998
      period_seconds: 1
      timeout_seconds: 5
      failure_threshold: 120
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
  clock:
    command: '''/usr/local/bin/appliance-clock.sh'''
    environment:
      - SERVICE_JWT=${SERVICE_JWT:-eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJyb2xlIjoic2VydmljZSIsInN1YiI6IjAwMDAwMDAwLTAwMDAtMDAwMC0wMDAwLTAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMCIsImV4cCI6MTk4ODE1MDQwMH0.dGYz_sMSnOvZy0eANh7spJbgyr2fEzeynOERIqW7gd4}
    depends_on:
      ticker:
        condition: process_healthy
    availability:
      restart: on_failure
  timer-check:
    command: '''psql'' ''-X'' ''--set=ON_ERROR_STOP=1'' ''--single-transaction'' ''--file=/timer-check.sql'''
APPLIANCE

RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -e' 'while sleep "${POKE_INTERVAL_SECONDS:-60}"; do' '  curl -fsS -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer ${SERVICE_JWT}" "http://ticker:9998/poke?caller=appliance" >/dev/null || { echo "clock: the ticker refused its poke" >&2; exit 1; }' 'done' > /usr/local/bin/appliance-clock.sh && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/appliance-clock.sh
epilogue: RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -e' 'if [ "$1" = "postgres" ]; then shift; fi' 'export PGDATA="${PGDATA:-/var/lib/pgsql/data}"' 'export POSTGRES_DB="${POSTGRES_DB:-truco}"' 'export PATH="/usr/lib/postgresql/18/bin:$PATH"' 'q=$(printf "\047")' 'if [ ! -s "$PGDATA/PG_VERSION" ]; then' '  mkdir -p "$PGDATA" /run/postgresql' '  chown -R postgres:postgres "$PGDATA" /run/postgresql' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups initdb -D "$PGDATA" --no-sync --encoding=UTF8 --auth=trust --locale-provider=icu --icu-locale=und --locale=C' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -w -o "-c listen_addresses='\'''\'' $*" start' '  if [ "$POSTGRES_DB" != "postgres" ]; then setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE \"$POSTGRES_DB\""; fi' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _pronto_migrations (name text primary key, applied_at timestamptz default now())"' '  for f in /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/*.sql; do' '    if [ -f "$f" ]; then' '      echo "Applying $f..."' '      setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -f "$f"' '      base=$(basename "$f")' '      setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "INSERT INTO _pronto_migrations (name) VALUES ($q$base$q) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING"' '    fi' '  done' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -m fast -w stop' 'else' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -w -o "-c listen_addresses='\'''\'' $*" start' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _pronto_migrations (name text primary key, applied_at timestamptz default now())"' '  for f in /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/*.sql; do' '    if [ -f "$f" ]; then' '      base=$(basename "$f")' '      case "$base" in *seed*) continue;; esac' '      applied=$(setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -t -A -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "SELECT count(*) FROM _pronto_migrations WHERE name = $q$base$q")' '      if [ "$applied" = "0" ]; then' '        echo "Applying pending migration $f..."' '        setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -f "$f"' '        setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups psql -U postgres -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "INSERT INTO _pronto_migrations (name) VALUES ($q$base$q)"' '      fi' '    fi' '  done' '  setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups pg_ctl -D "$PGDATA" -m fast -w stop' 'fi' 'exec setpriv --reuid=postgres --regid=postgres --clear-groups postgres -D "$PGDATA" -c listen_addresses=127.0.0.1 "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'if [ "$1" = "microcheck" ]; then' '  shift' '  exec "$@"' 'fi' 'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/bayt && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/bayt
RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do if [ "$1" = "--" ]; then shift; break; fi; shift; done' 'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/mise && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/mise

RUN printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'set -e' 'for n in crud database auth ticker; do' '  grep -Eq "^[^#]*[[:space:]]$n([[:space:]]|$)" /etc/hosts || echo "127.0.0.1 $n" >> /etc/hosts || { echo "appliance: cannot name $n in /etc/hosts" >&2; exit 1; }' 'done' 'export PORT="${PORT:-8080}"' 'export CADDY_HTTP_PORT="${PORT}"' 'export CADDY_TLS_HOST_PORT="${PORT}"' 'if [ -n "$ORIGIN" ]; then' '  if [ -z "$WEBAUTHN_RP_ID" ]; then' '    h="${ORIGIN#*://}"' '    h="${h%%/*}"' '    h="${h%%:*}"' '    if [ -n "$h" ] && [ "$h" != "localhost" ]; then export WEBAUTHN_RP_ID="$h"; fi' '  fi' '  if [ -z "$WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN" ] && [ -n "$WEBAUTHN_RP_ID" ] && [ "$WEBAUTHN_RP_ID" != "localhost" ]; then export WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN="$ORIGIN"; fi' 'fi' 'exec "$@"' > /usr/local/bin/appliance-entrypoint.sh && chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/appliance-entrypoint.sh

RUN awk 'skip { d += gsub(/\{/, "{") - gsub(/\}/, "}"); if (d <= 0) skip = 0; next } /handle @rendered \{/ { skip = 1; d = 1; next } { print }' /etc/caddy/Caddyfile > /tmp/Caddyfile && mv /tmp/Caddyfile /etc/caddy/Caddyfile
